title: Discovery of Asymmetric Spike-like Structures of the 10 au Disk around the Very Low-luminosity Protostar Embedded in the Taurus Dense Core MC 27/L1521F with ALMA
question: Is the ~10 au disk of the very low-luminosity Class 0 protostar in MC 27/L1521F resolved at ~0.03'' in 1.3 mm continuum, does it show extra (spike-like) structure, and what produces that structure

recipe.method: tclean with multi-scale deconvolver, manual clean masks, Briggs weighting robust = -1.0 chosen after trying several weightings
key_parameters: Briggs robust = -1.0 gives beam 0.024'' x 0.017'', rms 20 uJy/beam

recipe.goal: Measure disk size by 2D Gaussian fit
recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fit to the central bright source in the robust = -1.0 image, giving observed and beam-deconvolved FWHM

recipe.goal: Measure disk and total continuum flux
recipe.method: Disk flux from the Gaussian component compared with total flux of the detected emission over the displayed region

recipe.goal: Derive gas mass and H2 column density
recipe.method: Optically thin dust emission: M_gas = F d^2 / (kappa B(T_d)); N_H2 from beam intensity with mu = 2.8
key_parameters: Peak and edge beam intensities ~0.28 and ~0.06 mJy/beam
assumptions: Optically thin disk, T_d = 20 K, kappa(1.3 mm) = 0.01 cm^2 g^-1 per interstellar matter, mu_H2 = 2.8, d = 140 pc

recipe.goal: Characterise the spike components from the residual image
recipe.method: Subtract the Gaussian disk component from the 1.3 mm image and measure the excess flux, then convert with the same mass and column-density assumptions
Toomre Q from a simplified formula of Kratter & Lodato, using the disk mass and stellar mass
key_parameters: Disk mass ~4e-4 Msun, stellar mass ~0.2 Msun

recipe.goal: Estimate magnetic field needed for interchange instability at the disk edge
recipe.method: Lubow & Spruit onset condition B_init^2 > 2 pi Sigma0 G M*/r^2 and development condition B_dev^2/8pi > rho v^2 with free-fall v
key_parameters: Sigma0 ~5e24 cm^-2 at disk edge, r ~4 au, M* = 0.2 Msun
Envelope density 1e-13 g cm^-3; free-fall velocity ~9 km/s at 4 au
assumptions: Observed disk-edge densities not used for the infalling material because the disk is not smoothly connected to the envelope; envelope density adopted from numerical work

recipe.goal: Evaluate core-scale magnetic field and mass-to-flux ratio
recipe.method: DCF field strength from literature polarization dispersion and N2H+ line width, then mu_c from the Crutcher formula

recipe.goal: Estimate timescales and accretion rate for the interchange-instability scenario
recipe.method: Dynamical time = 2000 au / sound speed (0.2 km/s at 10 K); time-averaged accretion rate from 0.2 Msun over that time
assumptions: Arcs and spikes expand at the sound speed c_s = 0.2 km/s at 10 K

score_reason: Project code, band, configurations, CASA version, weighting and final beam/rms are given, but calibration, masks, multi-scale scales and fitting details are missing; derived values are numeric but depend on assumed T and kappa.
rediscovery_reason: The Cycle 5 project is old enough to be public (not stated by the paper), beam, rms and weighting are given for a check, and the main results (flux, size, mass, column density) are numeric; the imaging recipe is only partial.
